rooms.name: Antechamber
rooms.description: The mouth of the sanctum, where the covenant gathers. A stair of black glass leads down into the dark, and the way you came in has already sealed behind you.

rooms.name: Crossing
rooms.description: A four-way crossing beneath a vaulted ceiling. Passages run to a warded chamber on either hand, and an altar room lies ahead. The air hums, as if the stone is waiting to be answered.

rooms.name: North Ward
rooms.description: A narrow chamber ending in a disc of pale iron set flush with the floor -- the North Ward. It thrums faintly underfoot, but nothing you do alone will hold it.

rooms.name: South Ward
rooms.description: The twin of the far chamber: a disc of pale iron set into the floor -- the South Ward. It answers the tread of a single Warden with silence.

rooms.name: Reliquary
rooms.description: A low altar room, its walls carved with two figures standing apart, hands raised toward a seal between them. A cracked altar stone holds what the covenant left behind.

loot.name: altar-stone
loot.description: A cracked altar stone with a single tablet resting in its hollow.

narration.text: Two Wardens take the twin discs in the same breath, and the sanctum answers at last. The seal between the wards splits with a sound like a held note released -- and above you, the way out grinds open. You leave together, or not at all; tonight, it is together.

timeoutNarration.text: The lamps gutter out one by one. Whatever the covenant was meant to do here, it will not be done tonight — and the sanctum keeps those it is done with.
